The '''Tapani Defense Force''' was one of three roving [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] fleets that patrolled the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The other fleets were the [[Ground Pounders]] and [[Swift Wing]].

The Tapani Defense Force was the main battle group that patrolled the [[Shapani Bypass/Legends|Shapani Bypass]] and was the largest of the fleets with the most disciplined and trained personnel. The fleet would occasionally go on protracted tours of the sector to give a show of Imperial strength to the locals.
